description: Global runtime kill switch for the POSpire offline outbox path (D-29).

fields.description: Master switch for offline mode. When unchecked, all offline write enqueues throw OfflineDisabledError and the sync scheduler pauses. Existing queued entries remain untouched and resume when re-enabled.
fields.label: Offline Enabled
Retention
fields.description: Phase 2 retention controls for the offline-sync recovery pipeline. Aggressive defaults are safe — every relevant audit chain is on the recovery row itself, which is preserved until the archive job runs.

Number of days SINCE THE ROW WAS LAST MODIFIED (i.e. since it reached Resolved / Voided — that's the last time the row changes) after which it's auto-archived by the daily scheduled job. Setting 90 means 'archive Resolved/Voided rows that have sat untouched for 90 days'. Set to 0 to disable archival entirely (rows accumulate indefinitely). Legal-hold flagged rows are skipped regardless.
fields.label: Recovery Archive After (days since last change)

fields.description: Number of days after which the cashier device's local outbox tombstones (status synced / voided) are garbage-collected by the in-cycle vacuum pass. Server-side data is unaffected. Set to 0 to disable client GC.
fields.label: Client Tombstone Retention (days)

fields.description: Number of consecutive failed handoff attempts (one per drain cycle) before the cashier client surfaces a 'handoff stuck' warning to its observability beacon. Helps ops spot devices whose recovery.handoff calls keep failing despite reachable connectivity. Set to 0 to disable the escalation flag.
fields.label: Client Handoff Stuck Threshold (cycles)

fields.description: Free-form notes left for ops while the switch is flipped (incident reference, planned re-enable time, etc.). Visible only to System Managers.
fields.label: Notes
